lead_raw_text:
The structure of ZnCdBr₃ crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 20 atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd centers in octahedral environments with six Br neighbors, Zn centers in tetrahedral environments with four Br neighbors, and Br centers coordinated by one Cd and one Zn neighbor. The Zn tetrahedra and Cd octahedra share corners, while Cd octahedra share edges, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
